issues.summary: [Patient Medical Record] Missing general upload for historical medical documents without Doctor Request

issues.summary: [Patient / My Family] Missing parent self-service Create Child Patient Profile without child account
issues.result: Existing parent intake is wired to child-onboarding/search/review APIs and server workspace capabilities. It creates no child login and grants no medical rights before server review.

issues.summary: [FE GAP 01] Remove fabricated doctor ratings & review counts from public discovery
issues.result: Removed fake ratings/review counts and their CSS, dividers and translations from search and profile.

issues.summary: [FE GAP 02] Consolidate Patient Booking into one Shared Booking Drawer across Search and Doctor Details
issues.result: Shared patient-booking feature now owns options, eligible patients, createPatient, idempotency, conflict recovery and actual receipt; search and profile launch the same drawer. Removed duplicate booking TS/HTML/CSS. Explicit preselection is revalidated without silent substitution; login returns with non-sensitive intent.

issues.summary: [FE GAP 03] Family medical eligibility approval omits required policy and authority fields
issues.result: Typed eligibility approval now includes policyVersion, basisReference and authorityRelationshipRequestId; real verification metadata is displayed and missing approved references block approval. Backend still does not publish allowed policy/basis options for a new decision.

issues.summary: [FE GAP 04] Family restriction approval missing signed BasisReference
issues.result: Admin detail now unwraps the actual {case: ...} response; restriction approval cannot send a missing/invented signed ground. Restoration remains independent. A published signed-grounds selector contract is still required.

issues.summary: [FE GAP 05] Family medical evidence uses invalid document type values and unpaired files
issues.result: Removed Evidence/UpdatedEvidence pseudo-type fallbacks and enforce one type per file/count parity before POST. Approved per-file enum selection is unfinished because current API does not publish the policy's allowed evidence types.

issues.summary: [FE GAP 06] SuperAdmin family medical access type filter uses wrong query key
issues.result: Admin type query mapping corrected; patient requestType preserved; exact HTTP tests cover both types and all.

issues.summary: [FE GAP 07] Gate Family Medical Access actions by Phase 16 policy capabilities
issues.result: Patient create actions now require the selected authenticated-family child's authoritative restriction/restoration capabilities. Scope is rechecked before submit; history remains viewable. No environment-based or locally invented medical eligibility.

issues.summary: [FE GAP 08] Replace UUID-driven Family Medical Access forms with family-member selection
issues.result: Authenticated family-member name selectors replace raw patient UUID entry and display; selected child/adult IDs remain internal and current child capabilities are verified. Approved evidence selection remains dependent on WAS-868.

issues.summary: [FE GAP 09] Patient archived tickets show fabricated queue data and ignore cursor
issues.result: Dedicated archive projection; cursor/dedup/race handling; existing patient detail endpoint; no live queue banners.

issues.summary: [FE GAP 10] Archived reservations fabricate appointment time and drop NextCursor
issues.result: Dedicated archived reservations for all three actors; filters/cursors; removed fabricated 09:00, Morning, names and totals; archive-aware read-only details.

issues.summary: [FE GAP 11] Doctor Queue Archive button hidden despite Doctor archive API
issues.result: Doctor archive button, scoped endpoint, visible drawer and paging wired.

issues.summary: [FE GAP 12] Reception Queue Archive button loads data but does not show it
issues.result: Reception archive drawer, assigned-practice scope, paging and details wired.

issues.summary: [FE GAP 13] Add SuperAdmin archived Ticket and Reservation explorer
issues.result: Dedicated /admin/archives entry mode, server PracticeId filter, ticket/reference search, cursor paging and metadata detail endpoints. Correct Archives.* permissions; no worker health calls on archive entry and no fallback to stale details after failure.

issues.summary: [FE GAP 15] Reception scoped operational activity audit UI

issues.result: Typed identity Search before Basic/Full registration; explicit verified ConfirmReuse; server canCreate/claim flags remain authoritative; UUID Idempotency-Key on identity confirmations.

issues.summary: [FE GAP 18] Full Reception registration lacks DistinctPerson review for soft matches

issues.summary: [FE GAP 19] Reception patient contact linking requires search and selection instead of UUID
issues.result: Scoped PatientPicker replaces raw linked-contact GUID input. Selected name/phone shown, ID kept internal; changing practice clears selection and ignores stale search results.

issues.summary: [FE GAP 20] SuperAdmin patient duplicate review and classification UI missing
issues.result: SuperAdmin duplicate-case list/filter/details/classification route and navigation. NeedsMoreEvidence/ConfirmedDuplicate/DistinctPatients use rowVersion plus stable UUID; 409 refreshes details. No merge/delete APIs.

issues.summary: [FE GAP 21] Map public Practice address correctly (address vs detailedAddress)

issues.summary: [FE GAP 22] Remove unsubstantiated approximate waiting-time claim on doctor discovery cards
issues.result: Removed unsupported public wait estimate and obsolete translation.

issues.summary: [FE GAP 23] Clarify public consultation price as Normal New Consultation baseline
issues.result: Public baseline price now labelled standard new consultation; selected booking prices retain their API values.

issues.summary: [FE GAP 24] Doctor Practice dashboard must distinguish Active from Online Bookable readiness
issues.result: Practice readiness now reads authorized Doctor configuration plus Doctor profile and public practice projection. Active, online-enabled, effective bookability and no-listed-slot states are separate; fixing links use existing scoped configuration/schedule/pricing sections. Published disabled reasons OnlineBookingDisabled, NoPricing, NoAvailableCapacity and NoAvailableSchedule are shown in Arabic/English without invented reasons.

issues.result: Live Swagger has public portrait reads but no authenticated post-registration Doctor portrait mutation. Practice logo endpoints cannot be reused.

issues.result: Localized quota/release/priority/activation explanations match backend DoctorPracticeCatalog rules. Null means no protected quota, quota zero rejected, release zero retained as end-of-day. Bounds/integer/pair validation wired without changing backend algorithms.

issues.result: Historical medical document date rendered independently of upload timestamp; unknown clinical date explicitly labelled. Arabic DatePipe locale registered.

issues.summary: [FE GAP 31] Add Patient Medical Record Access Log screen
issues.result: Access-history UI wired; corrected patient-safe DTO and supported cursor-only query contract.

issues.summary: [FE GAP 33] Fix safe ReturnUrl restoration after Login for Doctor Discovery and protected routes
issues.result: Safe role-specific return navigation after login, public discovery intent preserved, unsafe URLs stripped, lifecycle/password gates retained, successful authentication survives navigation failures.

issues.summary: [FE GAP 34] Transient /auth/me errors wrongly clear valid restored sessions
issues.result: Transient /auth/me failures retain valid session and show accessible retry. Timeout and in-flight GET deduplication; stale-token responses ignored; expiry/401/403 still invalidate. No automatic mutation retry.

issues.summary: [FE GAP 35] Reception Today appointments use browser date instead of Clinic BusinessDate and stay stale across midnight
issues.result: Live Swagger and current source provide no Reception-authorized clinic timezone/business-clock response. Correct Today/Upcoming and midnight rollover remain unfinished; no Doctor management permission was broadened and no clinic timezone guessed.

issues.summary: [FE GAP 36] Medical record refresh mixes unfiltered overview with selected historical-document filter
issues.result: Refresh preserves the selected medical timeline filter, starts its matching cursor domain at page one and ignores outdated overview/timeline responses.

issues.summary: [FE GAP 37] Validate exact API origin before attaching JWT in AuthInterceptor
issues.result: Central URL parser enforces exact backend origin and path boundaries before JWT/locale injection or 401 logout. Anonymous onboarding checks only the verified URL pathname; foreign-origin errors cannot clear the session.

issues.summary: [FE GAP 38] My Family request pagination and history filters vulnerable to stale async responses
issues.result: Independent family request-page and relationship-history generations reject stale successes/errors/loaders. Workspace denial invalidates all pending groups and clears private state.

issues.summary: [FE GAP 39] My Family empty last page hides Previous pagination navigation
issues.result: Previous/page controls remain available on empty later history pages; onboarding next-page heuristic is distinct from governance's actual total. No invented onboarding totals.

issues.summary: [FE GAP 40] Dependent financial transactions and receipt views accept stale async responses
issues.result: Independent transaction-page and receipt generations prevent older financial responses from replacing current selection; context changes/destroy invalidate both.

issues.summary: [FE GAP 41] Prevent HTML injection / stored DOM-XSS risk in Walk-In ticket printing
issues.result: Ticket printing uses authored DOM and textContent, isolated popup, no document.write or inline script. All dynamic labels are text; blocked popups show a toast instead of printing the queue screen.

issues.summary: [FE GAP 42] Walk-In quick patient registration cannot handle guardian contact or identity-match review
issues.result: Removed the divergent in-queue registration form/mutation. Queue launches the approved reception matching/guardian registration flow, with same-session practice/token-bound memory handoff; return revalidates walk-in options and never creates a ticket automatically.

issues.summary: [FE GAP 43] Queue Ticket Details retain stale cached patient data on selection or 403/404
issues.result: Every ticket inspection clears prior patient/action context and shows loading until authoritative details return. Cached 401/403/404/409 no longer suppress errors or preserve stale details. Archives remain read-only.

issues.summary: [FE GAP 44] Patient Follow-Up history waits for unrelated BookablePatients API
issues.result: Follow-Up history starts immediately, independently of bookable-patient metadata. Metadata failure has separate safe fallback; denied history clears private state and all late metadata is ignored.

issues.summary: [FE GAP 45] Public Doctor Search allows stale filter results to overwrite newer searches
issues.result: Latest submitted doctor search/filter/page alone owns results/loading/errors; old results are cleared while a new query is pending.

issues.summary: [FE GAP 46] Doctor Discovery governorate/city/area dropdowns accept outdated async options
issues.result: Independent location generations and parent identity checks prevent stale city/area choices. Downstream controls are disabled during loads and localized failure/retry guidance is shown.

issues.summary: [FE GAP 47] Doctor Directory accumulates window resize listeners after route navigation
issues.result: The obsolete anonymous resize listener was removed with the shared-booking refactor; layout no longer registers a persistent window listener.

issues.summary: [FE GAP 48] Public Doctor booking drawer can show wrong doctor after close/reopen async race
issues.result: One shared booking generation invalidates open/close/Doctor/actor context; each asynchronous result checks current scope. Late responses and confirmations cannot overwrite a new Doctor or expose an old session's receipt.
